summary: Each candidate covers one piece: AmP has age-length and age-weight series for thousands of species, DATRAS has per-fish length, weight and age across 30 repeated surveys, MorphoSource has 25 cross-sectional ontogenetic-series specimens, and BioImage Archive has embryo time-lapses; none provides same-individual multi-axis measurements spanning more than a growing season, which the seasonal clause needs.
next_step: Use DATRAS length-weight-age by quarter as the length/weight proxy test of ratio constancy within vs across seasons; for true multi-axis form, compile longitudinal fish or reptile morphometric series from paper supplements or run a time-lapse.
obstacles_confirmed: The seasonal-duration assertion needs long time series rarely available.
Length and weight are a single-number proxy for multi-axis form.
